analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md. It bumps the date on head line 3, extends the resident recurrent checkpoint bank gate on head line 295 to include the plain unpublished Nemotron Super owner, and adds head lines 300-306 on `alignsRecurrentCheckpointsToPrefillChunks`. That text says Nemotron Super captures only at multiples of its fixed prefill chunk reached by whole chunks, so a restored request runs the same chunk partition as a cold one. No code, crypto, authorization, attestation or routing changed in the supplied evidence. The docs describe a model-gated opt-in resident tier, and the memory flag defaults off per invariant 1 and head lines 287-290. That keeps the change in T-041 territory: the cross-tenant TTFT oracle (SEC-035) and the resident tenant isolation by cacheSalt.

The doc claims a bit-for-bit continuation for Nemotron Super. That claim is unverified. The code (`NemotronSuperLocalPrefixCache`, `alignsRecurrentCheckpointsToPrefillChunks`) is outside the supplied evidence. The behavior is also not an SSD or at-rest change, so T-041's mitigations on HMAC names, the 30-minute TTL and KEK purge are unaffected.

The threat model has no recorded gap from this change. Possible follow-up for reviewers of the actual implementation PR: confirm the resident bank keeps cacheSalt and tenant scoping, and the model-identity binding, for the Nemotron Super owner. The base prefix-cache.md already states these for the bank. No finding is raised.
